title: Principal Left on the Plan and PracticePay Returned-Payment-Fee Relief
content:
**Rule.** The principal share of a returned-payment-fee relief on a PracticePay Patient Financing plan reads the principal left on the plan's ledger, the financed charge plus returned payments less payments and provider refunds: below 1000.00 USD gives 1, at least 1000.00 USD and below 3000.00 USD gives 0.95, and 3000.00 USD or more gives 0.9.

The principal left is worked from the plan's own ledger entries: the financed treatment charge, plus the amounts of all returned-payment entries, less the amounts of all payment entries and all provider refunds. Fees, interest and waivers do not enter it.

| Principal left | Principal share |
|---|---|
| below 1000.00 | 1 |
| 1000.00 up to but not including 3000.00 | 0.95 |
| 3000.00 or more | 0.9 |

*Hypothetical ledger.* Financed charge 4000.00; payments 1200.00; one returned payment of 200.00; a provider refund of 500.00. Principal left: 4000.00 plus 200.00 less 1200.00 less 500.00, that is 2500.00; share 0.95. Exactly 3000.00 would take 0.9; exactly 1000.00 would take 0.95.
